headline: Compensation for Victims of Fintech Dana Syariah (DSI) Reaches Rp1,07 T
summary: The Witness and Victim Protection Agency recorded compensation of Rp1.07 trillion for 5,102 victims of the Dana Syariah Indonesia fintech collapse.
why: Dana Syariah was a peer-to-peer sharia lending platform, and its collapse has shaped regulatory scrutiny of Indonesian fintech lenders.
original_headline: Nilai Ganti Rugi Korban Fintech Dana Syariah (DSI) Capai Rp1,07 T
